g.text: Digital modulation assigns bits to amplitude, frequency, phase, or I/Q points

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Waveform bits are1,0,1,1,0; BPSK maps1 to positive and0 to negative carrier. FSK phase is continuous by integration of the selected frequency. QPSK
and16-QAM panels are normalized constellation examples, independent of the binary waveform sequence. Practical pulse shaping is omitted.
